svg.title: One agent turn: the Session.run() loop sequence
svg.desc: Sequence diagram of one agent turn. The caller starts session.run; run_loop emits SystemEvent and UserEvent, then each turn re-injects skill context, builds context through ContextInjectionHook, streams the Provider, and emits assistant and usage events. On end_turn it returns ResultEvent(success). On tool_use the Scheduler validates calls, checks the offered-tool boundary, runs PreToolUse, asks the PermissionEngine, executes tools and returns result blocks; LoopGuard then decides to stop, force a final answer, or continue the loop.
